Open-drain = atom bit 0x16 (asm_test_atom_bit) selects mux 3 / 4 / 6 instead of 1 / 2 / 5. CFF: MIO_PIN_MODE bit 0 -> 1 (od vs out, 3 / 3 sites); QSF AUTO_OPEN_DRAIN_PINS only switches detection (constant-0 tri-state data), od vs od_off bit-identical
direction branch: atom bit 4 input, 5 output, 6 bidir (test_bit). in / out / tri / bidir share the same CFF PIN_MODE bit; they differ in CFF SLEW / PULLUP / PULLDOWN strength + PCI_DIODE_CLAMP groups
IO block groups: MIO_SELECT_IOST_DIRT 3 or 4 elements (4th = bit shared with a neighbouring pad or the bank VREF pad), element i = value bit i
vector<uint> first element = delta vs the previous vector of the same field; BLOCK_INFO m_block_lists restart at 0 per BLOCK_INFO (LAB instance cells equal the oracle-checked body run)

calculate_bits_traditional: addr' = (addr / W + hi) * W + addr % W + lo, W = m_num_ram_cols (6154), (hi << 16 | lo) = m_block_lists[1][instance]; W == 0: addr + cell. CFF-tagged (101) addresses add m_block_lists[3][instance]; literals (11) unchanged. No sign flip, no constant.
